exposure: antenatal and postnatal counseling regarding the expression of breast milk
outcome: percentage of preterm receiving expressed breast milk (EBM) within 24 hours of birth
time of receiving the first EBM
cohort: 17 very preterm babies (<32 weeks gestation) born within the study period in a tertiary care (Level III-B) NICU.
finding: A simple QI intervention successfully increased the percentage of preterm infants receiving EBM within 24 hours of birth from 20% to 90% and reduced the median time to first EBM from 32.5 hours to 17 hours.
